about: Memory budgets of the playground pages, checked by scripts/test-memory.mjs in every release and in the 8-hourly tier (xo decision 0615). Raising a budget is a deliberate commit that says why; nothing raises one automatically.

repl.what: the REPL compiler's wasm memory peak (MB) over the 30-entry session on /repl/

play.what: the /play/ tab renderer's peak memory footprint (MB, macOS phys_footprint_peak) over 30 builds and runs of the default program
play.baseline_from: xo 0.50.0, 2026-11-12: the highest of 3 runs (482, 472, 480 MB; 339 to 343 MB after the 30th run), headless Chrome on the development Mac (darwin/arm64)
